# 2 Chronicles 27 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 27 (9 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.2
- **EMET:** "And-he-did the-right in-eyes-of YHWH according-to-all that did Uzziah his-father only not he-entered to-temple-of YHWH and-still the-people were-actin"
- **LOGOS:** "And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD according to all that his father Uzziah had done — except he did not enter the temple of the LORD. B"
- **PNEUMA:** "He did what was right in the LORD's eyes, just as his father Uzziah had done — though unlike his father, he did not enter the LORD's temple. The peopl"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.3
- **EMET:** "He built gate-of house-of YHWH the-upper and-on wall-of the-Ophel he-built much."
- **LOGOS:** "He built the upper gate of the house of the LORD and did much building on the wall of Ophel."
- **PNEUMA:** "He rebuilt the Upper Gate of the LORD's temple and did extensive work on the wall at the hill of Ophel."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

## V.5
- **EMET:** "And-he he-fought with king-of sons-of Ammon and-he-prevailed over-them and-they-gave to-him sons-of Ammon in-the-year that a-hundred talents-of silver"
- **LOGOS:** "He fought with the king of the Ammonites and prevailed against them. The Ammonites gave him that year 100 talents of silver, 10,000 cors of wheat, and"
- **PNEUMA:** "He fought and defeated the king of the Ammonites. That year the Ammonites paid him 100 talents of silver, 10,000 cors of wheat, and 10,000 cors of bar"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

## V.6
- **EMET:** "And-he-became-mighty Jotham for he-established his-ways before YHWH his-God."
- **LOGOS:** "So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God."
- **PNEUMA:** "Jotham grew powerful because he walked steadfastly before the LORD his God."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.7
- **EMET:** "And-rest-of acts-of Jotham and-all his-wars and-his-ways behold-them written on book-of kings-of Israel and-Judah."
- **LOGOS:** "Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah."
- **PNEUMA:** "The other events of Jotham's reign, including all his wars and everything else he did, are recorded in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.9
- **EMET:** "And-he-lay-down Jotham with his-fathers and-they-buried-him in-city-of David and-he-reigned Ahaz his-son in-his-place."
- **LOGOS:** "And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David. And Ahaz his son reigned in his place."
- **PNEUMA:** "Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. His son Ahaz succeeded him as king."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.
